amendment: v1 exposed 2020-2021 holdout before audit found 33 training examples whose next auction outcome was already published at their origin. v2 excludes noncausal historical examples, keeps all forecasting methods/hyperparameters/selection unchanged, and uses previously unscored 2022-2024 holdout. v1 artifacts retained separately.
selection: Highest equal-family development mean among naive/rules/ridge/trees/ensemble. One global method. No selection on holdout.
metric: Official 5.2.2 predictive/interval composite via imported _composite. Separate exact citation audit. Non-rankable demo, no production NLI judge.
submission_requires: positive paired lower 95% time-block-bootstrap bound versus naive
auction_reference: Last six available auctions of the same tenor; 90% empirical absolute-error interval.
yield_reference: Zero change; 90% empirical absolute-error interval. Direction zero means non-up.
limitations: Two Treasury sources only; three rate targets share the same underlying observations.
Historical downloads are current snapshots, not certified historical vintages.
Task templates are authored by us; do not establish generalization to organizer corpora.
No earnings, CPI, credit or COT coverage in v1.
